text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Watching the footage of the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe, certainty takes hold. If 
Duramente had run in that race, she surely 
would have won. With her sheer strength...

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, first is the Kikuka Sho. 
Duramente seemed a little anxious about 
her lack of long-distance experience.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
However, she fully intends to win. When 
told that everything will be fine as long 
as that's the case, she smiles and says 
she feels relieved.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
In the Kikuka Sho paddock, Duramente 
caught sight of Kitasan Black. She later 
recounted that it felt as though she were 
facing a giant.
